sourceOrganization: Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Research Organization of Information and Systems

structures: bilateral abdominal, clavicular and sternocostal parts of pectoralis major

recipe: retain only the documented 50-structure thorax subset
crop only the skin mesh to source z=850..1500 mm, retaining the neck/lower-face orientation and upper thorax
apply deterministic per-structure vertex clustering (1.2-2.5 mm)
apply one identical source-to-glTF axis/unit/origin transform to every structure
generate indexed normals and package as uncompressed GLB

registration.basis: All source FJ meshes are members of one BodyParts3D 4.x body-coordinate system; no structure is individually moved, scaled or fitted.

anchors.source: Derived before optimization from named ribs, costal cartilages, sternum, left clavicle, pectoralis-major and skin geometry.
